rules.description: Block card number patterns (PCI DSS Req 3)
rules.message: Card number detected — never log or store PANs in plaintext.
rules.recommendation: Tokenise PAN before storage. Never log full PAN. Use a PCI-compliant tokenisation service or vault.

rules.message: CVV must never be stored post-authorization (PCI DSS 3.2.1).
rules.recommendation: Never store CVV/CVC, even encrypted. Discard immediately after authorisation per PCI DSS Requirement 3.2.

rules.message: TLS 1.0 is prohibited under PCI DSS — use TLS 1.2+.
rules.recommendation: Use TLS 1.2 or higher. Disable SSL 2/3, TLS 1.0, and TLS 1.1. Use strong cipher suites (AES-GCM, ChaCha20-Poly1305).
